evidence: The batch asserts exact guest/admin tab inventories and visits non-Chat/Pilot tabs; its report labels the result partial and separately defers Chat/Pilot.
Capture is only checked for presence, accessible label, and visible badge. It does not compare either value to pending/elsewhere source state.

Avatar checks establish an open menu and a desktop status string; they do not assert the guest/admin identity content. Admin Profile navigation is recorded after checking only that some active tabpanel exists.
The lazy-load observation checks selected trigger, visible active panel, and absence of a spinner-only fallback. It does not prove meaningful view content, error handling, or retry behavior.
Inventory T01/T03 explicitly remains partial: no reload or role-transition stale-selection fallback; member mode is unavailable. T09 active assistance is unavailable.
No Chat or Pilot action is performed, as required by the separate ownership boundary.
verdict_a.runtime_limit: Source-only review; no browser launch or live-surface evidence was performed by this peer.

evidence: The harness verifies the released artifact tree and receipt, creates a fresh profile, correlates DevTools with its spawned Chrome child, checks the extension and side-panel context, and cleans up only its owned child/profile.

The admin login is constrained to https://www.aimatrx.com/login with origin/path checks and a dashboard URL wait. Credentials are read from the local aidream .env, filled into the form, not placed in the report or stdout.
The batch does not inject auth/session state, intercept or synthesize chunk failures, fabricate pending data, or mutate backend records.
The catch branch discards the exception text and emits only a generic failure category; this weakens diagnosis but avoids leaking page or credential data.
limits: Credential delivery still depends on the real aimatrx.com login page being trustworthy; no runtime/network inspection was performed.
The report path is under test-results and is written with mode 0600, but an existing file's mode is not tightened by writeFile's mode option.
The report's per-target pass helper is used for observations whose predicates do not prove the inventory's full expected behavior; root must retain partial status.

follow_up: Keep the submitted batch status partial; do not translate its observed subsets to complete T01/T03/T06/T13/T15 passes.
For any later extension, make Profile readiness identify the Profile view and its expected content; make lazy-load evidence identify usable view content.
Keep credentials and detailed exceptions out of artifacts; preserve only sanitized error classes if diagnosis is needed.
